title: Integrate knowledge flow and untrusted-text isolation

checks.name: diagnosis_to_snapshot
checks.result: A Phase-A DirectorProblemSet validates diagnostic questions and rejects fixed shot answers. Retrieval uses only the explicit diagnosis/query terms, holds execution-stage cards until explicit blocking approval, applies metadata hard filters and minimal budgets, then seals query, candidates, selection reasons, exclusions, conflicts, source/card hashes and budgets into a tamper-detectable replay snapshot.

checks.name: no_full_library_load
checks.result: Runtime knowledge access is metadata-only. K0/offline and v4/archive sources are fail-closed for raw-text operations; the catalog accepts prebuilt capsule metadata and the retrieval path has no source-file reader or template fallback.

checks.name: prompt_injection_blocked
checks.result: Scripts, raw knowledge and other external text are enveloped as untrusted data with source/project/hash metadata. Instruction-like payloads are quarantined into HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED security events and excluded from active packets and snapshots; cross-project evidence is also blocked.

checks.name: vertical_fixture_uses_knowledge
checks.result: The vertical fixture now executes FactRegistry -> Phase-A artifact -> metadata catalog retrieval -> sealed snapshot before using an independently valid R1.4 Golden VEC for synchronized storyboard/video rendering. This proves the knowledge chain is connected without falsely claiming that the historical Golden shot was generated by this retrieval run.

compatibility.director_creative_semantics: not implemented in R2.3; Phase-B creative synthesis remains a later controlled work package
